dependencies.label: Electron runtime bundle
dependencies.installHint: Install the NEURODECK AppImage or portable package produced by package:steamdeck.

dependencies.label: Rust sidecar bridge
dependencies.installHint: Package the release sidecar into the Linux and Windows artifacts.

dependencies.label: Gamescope
dependencies.installHint: Install gamescope on SteamOS/Desktop Linux for native 1280x800 Game Mode launch.

dependencies.label: Steam client
dependencies.installHint: Install the Steam client to add the generated helper launcher to the Steam library.

dependencies.label: Proton compatibility tools
dependencies.installHint: Install a Proton toolchain in Steam for secondary Windows artifact validation.

dependencies.label: VPN and proxy system tools
dependencies.installHint: Install openvpn, wireguard, or NetworkManager only if the Browser VPN feature is required.

dependencies.label: Configured model runtime
dependencies.installHint: Set GEMINI_API_KEY or configure Ollama in llm-term.toml for live AI responses.
